All Mobile Games (Android and iOS) releasing in August 2026

Saurabh ShettyAugust 4, 2026Last Updated: August 3, 2026
0 4 minutes read

Every month brings a fresh batch of mobile games, but August 2026 looks particularly promising. Several long-awaited titles are finally arriving, while a number of new games are preparing to make their first impression on players worldwide. This list aims to present each one of those releases with the best picks on offer.

Upcoming Mobile Games releasing in August 2026 on Android and iOS

Here’s a list of mobile games arriving on Android and iOS in August 2026.

Major Mobile Games Releases to look forward to in August 2026 for Android and iOS

Table Of Contents
  1. 1. Reigns: Beyond
  2. 2. JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Golden Spirit
  3. 3. Gangstar Mirage City
  4. 4. Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun Boom
  5. 5. Dave The Diver

1. Reigns: Beyond

Release Date: August 12, 2026

Reigns: Beyond takes the familiar swipe-based decisions from the series and puts you in a completely different role. Instead of ruling kingdoms, you’re managing an intergalactic indie rock band trying to become famous across the galaxy. Every choice you make can affect your crew, your resources, and whether your band reaches the next planet.

Along the way, you’ll meet strange alien characters, perform concerts, upgrade your ship, and deal with unexpected situations during your journey. With hundreds of decisions and a unique space-rock theme, this feels like a fresh twist for both Reigns fans and new players.

2. JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Golden Spirit

Release Date: August 13, 2026

JoJo fans have another reason to be excited with Golden Spirit, an officially licensed RPG based on the legendary anime series. Following the Japan release, the game brings characters from different generations of JoJo together, letting you build teams with your favourite Stand users and experience those iconic battles in a new way.

The focus here is not just on flashy attacks but also on strategy, with team combinations, Stand abilities, and the RUSH system playing an important role during fights. Add detailed 3D models, Live2D scenes, and recreated anime moments, and this looks like a release made specifically for longtime fans.

3. Gangstar Mirage City

Release Date: August 20, 2026

Might not be a full-fledged global release, but definitely a game to keep an eye on this month. The Gangstar series returns with Mirage City, bringing back the open-world crime action that fans have enjoyed over the years.

Officially licensed by Gameloft and published by Level Infinite, you’ll be building your own criminal empire, taking on missions, driving across the city, and working your way toward becoming the biggest name on the streets.

The game also adds more multiplayer-focused features, including co-op heists and PvP battles. Along with customizing weapons, collecting cars, and expanding your businesses, there’s a lot more to manage than just completing missions. If you enjoy open-world action games on mobile, this should be your pick.

4. Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun Boom

Release Date: August 26, 2026

Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun Boom brings the brutal world of the Imperium to mobile with a fast-paced first-person shooter experience. You step into the role of a Space Marine and fight your way through waves of Chaos enemies using powerful weapons from the Warhammer universe.

The game focuses on old-school FPS action with large battlefields, explosive combat, and plenty of enemies to take down. With a full campaign, no energy systems, and mobile-optimized controls, this looks like a solid option for players who want a premium shooter experience on their phones.

5. Dave The Diver

Release Date: August 27, 2026

One of the most loved indie adventures is finally making its way to mobile with DAVE THE DIVER. The game mixes underwater exploration with restaurant management, so your day is split between diving into the ocean to discover new creatures and running a sushi restaurant at night.

The mobile version is being redesigned with a new experience in mind, making it easier to enjoy on smaller screens. You’ll explore the mysterious Blue Hole, collect ingredients, meet interesting characters, and slowly improve your restaurant. If you missed this award-winning adventure on other platforms, the mobile release is a great chance to jump in.
